releases.body:
## What's Changed
* feat: mark perk-injected turns with origin metadata by @noemit in https://github.com/rndmcnlly/opencode-perk/pull/8

## New Contributors
* @noemit made their first contribution in https://github.com/rndmcnlly/opencode-perk/pull/8

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/rndmcnlly/opencode-perk/compare/v0.4.0...v0.6.2

## What changed

- Add per-call `coalesce_seconds` control for drip spikes
- Default coalescing to 1.0 second and clamp values below 0.3 seconds
- Keep the 300 ms monitor poll so completion detection remains responsive
- Tighten the `bash_background` tool description
- Expand deterministic and agentic coverage for custom/default coalescing

## Verification

- `npm run check` (12 tests)
- Live OpenCode agent tests for default, custom, and below-floor behavior
- `npm pack --dry-run`
